svg.aria-label: Captured tool output forks two ways. Upward, the Findings Pipeline projects it into typed rows in code, routes them to a domain analyst, and carries the analyst's judgement out to HypothesisFindings -- only the analyst step is model-authored. Downward, the Evidence Store persists the same raw output to evidence.json for replay, audit, and citation resolution. No pipeline step ever reads evidence.json; the two halves are joined only by Evidence.id, carried on ResultSet.evidence_id, citation_evidence, and Exhibit.evidence_ids.
svg.title: Findings Pipeline and Evidence Store: one capture, two paths that never rejoin
svg.desc: Flow diagram of the SmartOps SOC Findings Pipeline and Evidence Store. Raw tool output is captured once, then projected into typed findings for the analysts (upper band, code except the analyst) and persisted raw to disk (lower band). The pipeline never reads the store; the only link between them is the Evidence.id chain.
svg.text: Findings Pipeline & Evidence Store — one capture, two paths that never rejoin
SmartOps SOC — projected typed rows go to the analyst; the raw output they came from goes to disk
projected, typed rows — tool result to judgement
the raw output those rows were projected from
the only model-authored step — every other box is code
No pipeline step ever reads evidence.json.
The analysts read ResultSet.rows out of report.json. When projection under-reports, the correct rows
sitting in evidence.json are unreachable by any code path — it has happened twice.
joined by id, not by data flow
replay a run at zero cost
Raw tool output is captured once and forks. Upward, code projects it into typed rows, routes them by CIM category, packs them under a token budget, and carries
the analyst's judgement out to HypothesisFindings — the analyst (amber) is the only step a model authors. Downward, the same output is persisted raw for replay,
audit, and citation resolution. The two never rejoin: no pipeline step reads evidence.json (red), and the only thing crossing the gap is the Evidence.id chain (violet).
